name: Story of a Wanderer
source:
Story of a Wanderer is an original visual novel game set in the Edo period. The story follows Kuro, a ronin that travels from place to place. Surviving with coins he receives from his killing services, Kuro is surprised when a strange teenager asks him to find a woman that mysteriously disappeared. Accepting the deal, both begin their journey together, with many shenanigans on the way.

[from [url=https://thekikkakibaz.itch.io/story-of-a-wanderer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《流浪者物语》是一款以江户时代为背景的原创视觉小说游戏。故事讲述了浪人库洛（Kuro）四处旅行的故事。库洛依靠从杀戮服务中获得的硬币生存下来，当一名奇怪的青少年要求他寻找一名神秘失踪的女人时，他感到惊讶。接受这笔交易后，两人一起开始了他们的旅程，途中发生了许多恶作剧。

[来自[url=https://thekikkakibaz.itch.io/story-of-a-wanderer]itch.io[/url]]
